# The screen block, limited to Libertty's own windows (own=1: never a
# display or another app's window): this probe's window listed, shown, its
# frames arriving; stopped.

wait:0.5

page-wait:go
expect-tab:Screen
expect-page:Windows
expect-page-not:Displays
page-click:css:.row[data-kind="window"]
page-click:Show
page-js:new Promise(r => { const t = setInterval(() => { const s = window.libertty_screen; if (s && s.frames >= 3) { clearInterval(t); r("frames " + s.width); } }, 100); setTimeout(() => r("no frames"), 10000); }) ==> frames
